newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico construction total value up 8.3 pct in Aug.
newsitem.headline: Mexico construction total value up 8.3 pct in Aug.

text.p: The total value of construction work carried out by registered firms in Mexico in August rose 8.3 percent in real terms against the same month last year, government statistics institute INEGI said Wednesday.
The total value of construction in August totalled 2.123 billion constant pesos in 1994 terms, up from 1.959 billion constant pesos from August of last year.
August marked the fifth straight month of increases in construction activity over last year, INEGI said.

The total of the construction work was split between buildings (30.4 percent), transport (20.1 percent), oil and petrochemicals (19.3 percent), other construction (14.3 percent), electricity and communications (8.4 percent) and water, drainage and irrigation (7.5 percent).
INEGI said in a statement the number of people employed in construction grew by 15 percent in August of this year over August 1995, but it did not report the actual number of workers.
